delete.body: Deleting removes every room, character, message and roll of this chronicle. This cannot be undone.

rooms.oocAlwaysOpen: The OOC lobby cannot be closed.
rooms.deleteBody: All messages in this room are deleted too. This cannot be undone.
rooms.forbidden: Only the Storyteller of this chronicle or an admin can change its locations.

rooms.descriptionHint: Shown under the room name; the AI Storyteller reads it too.

edition.classicHint: d10 vs target number, 1s cancel, botches
edition.locked: The edition is locked once the chronicle is created.

creation.title: Character creation rules
creation.intro: What the V5 forge offers new characters in this chronicle. Characters already made are not changed.
creation.booksHint: The forge offers clans, predator types, powers, rituals, ceremonies, Advantages and loresheets from the ticked books only; one printed in several books needs one of them. With every book ticked, books added to the catalog later count too.
creation.flawsMax: Most Flaw dots a player may take (empty = no limit)
creation.fledgling: Offer just-Embraced fledglings the Humanity 8 start
creation.houseRules: House rules (shown at the top of the forge)
creation.flawsHint: Ancillae take 4 Flaw dots, so a limit under 4 needs ancillae left out.
creation.savedCap: Advantage dots a player may leave unspent and save for later (0–20)
creation.savedSpecialty: Players may save the free specialty of their choice
creation.stModeAiHint: Spends that follow the rules are approved at once by a fixed rule check (not the language model) and logged under Approvals, where you can reverse any of them. House rules always wait for you.
creation.stModeHumanHint: Every spend waits for you under Approvals.
creation.stModeSuggest: You play a character in this chronicle yourself. With the AI Storyteller, the rule check approves your own spends instead of you.

approvals.approved: Approved and added to the sheet.
approvals.reversed: Reversed: the sheet is as it was before.
approvals.title: Approvals
approvals.introAi: AI Storyteller mode: spends of saved points that follow the rules are approved at once by the rule check and listed here; you can reverse them. House rules wait for you.
approvals.intro: Players spend the points they saved at creation here; nothing changes on a sheet until you approve.
approvals.nowHouseRule: The sheet changed since the player asked: this spend breaks the rules now.
approvals.confirmNeeded: This spend breaks the rules now: check the problems and confirm.

soFar.title: The chronicle so far
soFar.lead: The chat written up as a story, night by night, by the local model. It only runs when you press Update, and waits for a quiet moment in play.
soFar.estimating: Working out how long it takes…
soFar.estimate: This will take about {{minutes}} min: {{nights}} nights to write, then the summary.
soFar.estimateShort: This will take less than a minute: {{nights}} nights to write, then the summary.
soFar.estimateNone: Nothing new to write; the summary is checked again.
soFar.capped: It stops after {{max}} nights ({{total}} are waiting); press Update again to carry on.
soFar.notEnough: Nothing to tell yet: write a few scenes first.
soFar.waitingHint: The writer starts after {{minutes}} minutes with no new message, so play comes first.
soFar.eras: Joining the nights into the story so far…
soFar.newSince: New messages since the last update.
soFar.loadFailed: Could not load the chronicle so far.
soFar.tooSoon: Update was pressed a moment ago; try again in {{seconds}} s.
soFar.errContext: a night did not fit the model’s context
soFar.errJson: the model did not answer in the expected form
soFar.errOther: something went wrong on the server
soFar.rewriteNote: Every night is written again, the oldest first.
soFar.forbidden: Only the Storyteller and site admins can update the chronicle so far.
soFar.noWorker: The writer isn’t running on this server.
soFar.errTranslate: the translator gave no usable text
soFar.errNoDigest: there is no story so far to translate yet
soFar.editLoadFailed: Could not open the story for editing.
soFar.editTooLong: The story is too long to save.
soFar.edited: Exports of the story use your edited copy (the minutes stay as written).
soFar.newer: The story so far was written again after your edit.
soFar.editHint: Your copy of the whole story. The written text is kept apart; exports of the story use this copy.
soFar.translateShort: Translating {{texts}} texts takes less than a minute.
soFar.translationStale: The story was written again since; translate again to catch up.
